content:
**#821 — only the blobs THIS merge introduces are exempt from staged-records-check**

staged-records-check refused the commit that finishes a merge whenever the trunk added .memory/records/ since the branch forked, and the remedy it printed (git restore --staged + rm) made the merge result OMIT those records, which propagates as a DELETION when the branch merges back. Measured in a throwaway repo before writing the fix: trunk adds a record, feature merges trunk, follow the printed remedy, merge feature back, the record is gone from the trunk.

THE REFRAMING: the question the gate was missing is not 'am I mid-merge?' but 'did THIS MERGE introduce THIS BLOB?'. staged-records-check.test.mjs:227 deliberately wants the gate live mid-merge and it stays live: a record re-exported locally during a merge is absent from MERGE_HEAD at that path and is still refused. My first diagnosis ('the hook has no merge awareness') was WRONG and was corrected before the ticket was written.

IMPLEMENTATION: mergeIntroducedRecords({root, _spawn}) reuses parseLsTree and the exporter's own ls-tree command form at a second call site, the same argument the file header makes for sharing upstreamRecordEntries' predicate instead of growing a second rule. One line in the pure evaluator. Wired through a _mergeIntroducedRecords seam like every other input. Every failure of the MERGE_HEAD lookup (no merge, octopus MERGE_HEAD that --verify refuses, unreadable tree) returns ok:false and leaves the pre-821 verdict standing: a question this gate cannot ask must not ALLOW a restage.

TICKET ITEM 4 RESOLVED BY CONSTRUCTION, no text change needed: where the gate still refuses, the path is absent from HEAD (or git would not stage it) and absent from MERGE_HEAD (or the exemption applies), so no parent holds it and unstaging creates no deletion.

MEASURED against real git, four scenarios: merge carries the record fail->PASS; no merge + restage of a trunk copy FAIL unchanged; mid-merge + restage not carried FAIL unchanged; removing the exemption turns 3 tests red. Suite 4527 pass / 0 fail (+7). repo:check and brain:nav clean.

GOTCHA: the first lab had no origin remote, so the upstream lookup was unavailable and the gate degraded to PASS. That green would have appeared without the fix. Rebuilt with a real bare remote before trusting it. Also --no-ff is load-bearing in the integration test: the fixture branch forks before the trunk record, so a plain merge FAST-FORWARDS and writes no MERGE_HEAD.
